text: Emergency contraceptive pills (like Plan B) can end a pregnancy in its early stages.

room.label: U.S. adults who have heard of the pills
room.note: VERIFY before shipping: KFF reports 73% incorrect and 27% correct among adults who have heard of EC pills (66% of women 18–49). Confirm in the topline whether 'not sure' was a separate option or folded into the 73%, and set n to the heard-of subgroup.

truthSource.label: FDA, Plan B One-Step information
truthSource.oneLine: Plan B works by preventing or delaying ovulation; it does not end an existing pregnancy.
